title: Real-Time Distributed Task & Kanban Platform
problem_statement: Engineering teams struggle with asynchronous state synchronization and delayed task updates across distributed workspaces.
milestones: Milestone 1: Design relational database schema for boards, cards, and team permissions with SQLAlchemy and PostgreSQL.
Milestone 2: Implement FastAPI REST endpoints with JWT authentication and WebSocket channels for live board broadcasts.
Milestone 3: Build responsive React drag-and-drop Kanban frontend using Tailwind CSS and optimistic UI state updates.
Milestone 4: Containerize backend, database, and Redis cache with Docker Compose; set up automated healthcheck endpoints.
resume_bullet: Architected a real-time collaborative Kanban platform serving 50+ concurrent users with FastAPI and Redis WebSockets, reducing state sync latency by 45%.

problem_statement: Internal teams spend excessive hours searching unstructured PDF documentation and technical manuals without contextual answers.
milestones: Milestone 1: Build document ingestion pipeline parsing PDFs, chunking technical paragraphs with sliding window tokenization.
Milestone 2: Generate all-MiniLM-L6-v2 vector embeddings and index embeddings in an in-memory vector store.
Milestone 3: Develop FastAPI query endpoint performing cosine similarity semantic ranking with reranking fallbacks.
Milestone 4: Package microservice in a multi-stage Docker container with automated PyTest unit coverage above 85%.
resume_bullet: Developed an AI semantic search microservice using Sentence Transformers and FastAPI, accelerating document discovery speed by 60% across 5,000+ files.

Milestone 3: Configure automated container tagging and push to AWS ECR with semantic versioning triggers.
Milestone 4: Deploy automated staging rollback scripts using Bash and AWS CLI alerts upon failed health checks.
resume_bullet: Engineered a cloud CI/CD pipeline using GitHub Actions, Docker, and AWS, cutting staging release lead time from 40 minutes to under 4 minutes.

title: Interactive High-Throughput Analytics & Metrics Engine
problem_statement: Financial operations managers lack real-time visibility into high-volume transaction aggregations and anomaly alerts.
milestones: Milestone 1: Design optimized SQL analytical queries with window functions, composite indexes, and aggregated materialized views.
Milestone 2: Build strongly-typed RESTful API endpoints with request validation and rate limiting.
Milestone 3: Construct interactive dashboard interface featuring Recharts time-series graphs, KPI filter cards, and pagination.
Milestone 4: Implement local caching and memoized computations to maintain smooth 60 FPS UI transitions during data refreshes.
resume_bullet: Built an analytics dashboard in React, TypeScript, and PostgreSQL indexing 100k+ records, lowering database query execution time by 52% with materialized views.

title: High-Throughput API Rate Limiter & Caching Layer
problem_statement: Public API gateways are vulnerable to DDoS bursts and sudden query spikes that exhaust downstream database connections.
milestones: Milestone 1: Formulate sliding window counter rate-limiting algorithm in Redis Lua scripts to prevent concurrency race conditions.
Milestone 2: Integrate FastAPI middleware inspecting client IP headers, API tokens, and quota tiers.
Milestone 3: Conduct stress and load testing with Locust simulating 2,000 requests/sec with zero thread deadlocks.
Milestone 4: Package into a reusable standalone Dockerized middleware proxy with custom telemetry headers.
resume_bullet: Designed an asynchronous rate limiting middleware in FastAPI and Redis handling 2,000+ RPS, preventing API exhaustion and shielding backend databases.

title: Modular E-Commerce Inventory & Order Service
problem_statement: Monolithic store backends fail under flash sales due to tight coupling between product catalog queries and inventory checkouts.
milestones: Milestone 1: Define GraphQL schema types, queries, and mutations for flexible catalog filtering and cart mutations.
Milestone 2: Implement DataLoader batching and caching patterns to eliminate N+1 database queries on related collections.
Milestone 3: Establish atomic MongoDB transactional reservations during checkout to prevent duplicate inventory deductions.
Milestone 4: Write end-to-end integration tests using Jest and supertest covering concurrency edge cases.
resume_bullet: Constructed a high-concurrency inventory service using Apollo GraphQL, Node.js, and MongoDB, eradicating N+1 queries and preserving zero oversell consistency.
